capabilities: create mindmaps from the file list context menu
extras: README is minimal and also available in Chinese; it only explains how to create a mindmap file, not how to edit or export one.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to create or view notes as mindmaps.

relations.evidence: This is An Obsidian plugin for creating Mindmaps, based on vue3-mindmap.

summary: Mindmap note creator that lets users build mindmaps as special files from the file list context menu.
